source_text: Controversy erupted in 1867 when the Obstetrical Society of London investigated Brown's practices, censuring him for operating without patient consent—often on institutionalized women—and for unsubstantiated claims of efficacy, leading to his professional ostracism and death in obscurity in 1873. [30]
